Questions

Short answers to the things people ask most.

Where are my notes stored?

In a folder on your computer. Settings → Your files shows the path and opens it. Nothing is uploaded.

What’s the difference between Note view and Page view?

Note view is a continuous canvas for quick writing. Page view shows real pages with margins, headers, footers and page numbers. Switch any time with the Note | Page switch; nothing is lost.

How do I export a document?

••• menu → Export, choose a format, then choose where to save it. Files → Exports keeps a list of what you exported.

Does Doceo sync between my computers?

Not yet. Copy the data folder (Settings → Your files) to move or back up your library. Calendar links and Microsoft sign-in only read your calendar.

How do I see my Teams meetings?

In Calendar choose Add calendar → Microsoft 365 / Teams and follow the steps, or subscribe to your Outlook calendar link. Meetings show up with their join links, also on the Dashboard.

Can I use it offline?

Yes. Everything works without a connection; only calendar feeds and link previews need one.

How do I get my Notion, Obsidian, Confluence or Jira work in?

Notes: + on All notes → Import…. Jira issues: Tasks → the import icon, with a CSV export from Jira.

How do I get Databases to show up?

Settings → Features → Databases → Show.
